name: Snes9x PS5
summary: A dedicated Super Nintendo app with a 3D cover-flow shelf and multitap support.
description: A native port of Snes9x 1.63 as a standalone app with automatic covers, battery saves, save states, cheat files and IPS/UPS/BPS patches. Supports up to four DualSense pads for multitap games. No netplay or rewind.
author: MisterTemaki
